name: Lower Wisconsin State Riverway
blurb: The Lower Wisconsin State Riverway below the Prairie du Sac dam: a big, sandbar-braided river between WDNR-listed public landings.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

sections.notes: Arrange a vehicle shuttle between the named public accesses. Published landing-to-landing mileage and canoeing time (2 hours 36 minutes). At Arena, check the river connection in advance: shifting sandbars can require a carry or a shallow-channel approach.

takeOutAccess.note: DNR lists Arena as a public access and identifies its approach in the 2016 master plan, printed page 17. The old guide coordinate lies on a sandbar in the reviewed imagery. This approximate area was refined to the visible access approach; it is not a surveyed landing, a confirmed trailer ramp or a mapped connection to the main channel.
takeOutAccess.directions: Follow the public access road north from Village Edge Road and River Road in Arena. The marker identifies the road and parking approach. Check the river connection before launching or arranging a takeout; sandbars can require a carry or paddling through a shallow channel.
